automations.name: Report classification
automations.description: Every incoming report is read, translated where needed, and assigned a category and severity.

automations.name: Duplicate detection & clustering
automations.description: Reports describing the same fault at the same place are folded into one problem cluster.

automations.name: Priority recalculation
automations.description: Scores every open problem against the published weighting whenever its inputs change.

automations.name: Department routing
automations.description: Maps category plus jurisdiction to the owning department. Overrides are logged against the officer.

automations.name: Officer recommendation
automations.description: Suggests the assignee with the lowest weighted load and the right ward experience.

automations.name: Sponsorship eligibility check
automations.description: Tests each validated problem against state CSR guidelines and the ₹2 L floor.

automations.name: Industry match generation
automations.description: Scores sponsors on CSR theme, geography, unspent budget and historic response rate.

automations.name: Sponsorship reminders
automations.description: Reminds invited sponsors at 50% and 85% of the response window.

automations.name: Government funding fallback
automations.description: When the industry window closes without an acceptance, the problem moves itself into the funding queue with a recommended source.

automations.name: SLA escalation
automations.description: Escalates a breached problem one administrative level and notifies the next officer.

automations.name: Citizen progress notifications
automations.description: Tells every reporter when their problem changes stage, in the language they reported in.

automations.name: Resolution verification requests
automations.description: Asks the original reporters to confirm a completed fix before it can be closed.

automations.name: Impact computation
automations.description: Compares before and after report volume, cost and beneficiaries once verification closes.
